insights.summary: The agent performed a high-quality systematic optimization of the MoE subsystem. It went beyond simple 'zeros-to-empty' replacements by refactoring the FlashInfer integration and improving the routing logic in grouped_topk. The run was successful and adhered to all constraints.
strengths: Excellent understanding of vLLM's environment variable and configuration system.
Strict adherence to complex task constraints and iteration limits.
weaknesses: Inability to verify performance gains due to environment constraints.
